name: comp-147

frames.best_why: Two cards are ticked at once, showing the grid works as a multi-select with clear checked styling.

tagline: A grid of icon cards you tick to pick several tools at once.
summary: Four small cards in two columns, each with a faded icon, an empty checkbox and a tool name. Clicking a card ticks its box and several can be chosen together.
appearance: A two-by-two grid of dark rounded cards with thin outlines on a near-black stage. Each card shows a faint icon at the left, a square checkbox at the right and a white label low in the tile; a ticked card fills its box white with a dark check.
behaviour: Clicking anywhere on a card ticks its checkbox and tints the card border, and multiple cards can stay ticked. Hovering lightens a card's checkbox and outline without selecting it.
demo_content: The four labels Palette, Brush, Eraser and Cut.
search_phrases: check boxes in a two column grid
use_when: Users pick several related tools or categories and each option benefits from an icon and a name.
avoid_when: Only four fixed options exist with fixed icons, and ticks are never reported outside the cards.
customise: Options come from an items array of icon, label and value; the two-column layout and card styling are fixed in the file.
weight_why: Four small cards with icons and plain checkboxes; nothing animates.

a11y.note: Each card is a label for its own checkbox and icons are hidden, but the card surface has no focus ring.

polish_why: Even two-column grid with clear ticks; plain cards and small icons keep it standard.
title: Icon Grid Checkboxes
